plain_english_policy: Criminalizing employers who hire undocumented immigrants, with no explicit mention of enforcement mechanisms or penalties beyond the act itself.

effects.rationale: Criminalizing employment of undocumented immigrants directly restricts their ability to work legally, effectively reducing immigration access.
By criminalizing hiring practices, the policy indirectly limits labor rights for undocumented workers by making employment illegal.

evidence_quote: Criminalize the employment of an undocumented immigrant
